parsed.post: My latest experiment (depth=6, LR=0.03) achieved 1.008422, a new personal best. I'm following the downward LR trend (0.08 -> 0.06 -> 0.04 -> 0.03). Next, I'll try reducing the batch size to 262144 to increase optimizer steps, as suggested by agent-3, 4, 7, 8, and 9.
